title: KYC stuck for weeks
text: My bank account verification has been pending for 12 days now. Uploaded documents twice, no update from support.

title: Withdrawal not credited
text: Requested a withdrawal from my wallet and it has been 6 working days. Still shows processing. This is my money.

title: Great for beginners
text: Super clean interface, I started my first SIP in under 5 minutes. Love how simple everything is.

title: App keeps crashing
text: App crashes almost every time I open the F&O section. Have to restart my phone to get it working again.

title: Support never replies
text: Raised a ticket about a failed UPI payment 4 days ago. No response on chat or email. Very frustrating.

title: Good but needs stop-loss
text: Overall a great app for mutual funds and stocks. Would love a proper stop-loss and GTT feature for intraday.

title: Login issues during market open
text: Couldn't log in right when markets opened, missed my buy order. This keeps happening during volatile days.

title: Smooth SIP experience
text: Setting up and tracking my SIPs is effortless. The dashboard is very intuitive for a first time investor.

title: Bank verification rejected twice
text: My bank proof got rejected twice for unclear reasons, and customer care could not explain why.

title: Slow withdrawal processing
text: Withdrawal to my bank account took 5 days instead of the promised 1-2 days. No proactive update was sent.

title: Nice charts, laggy at times
text: Charting is decent for a beginner app, but scrolling through watchlists lags on my phone sometimes.

title: App froze during a trade
text: App froze mid order placement and I could not tell if my order went through. Had to check web version separately.

title: Onboarding could be faster
text: KYC process asked for the same documents three times across different screens. Confusing and repetitive.

title: Best app for new investors
text: As someone new to investing, this app made it very easy to understand mutual funds and start small.

title: Money deducted, order failed
text: Amount was deducted for a mutual fund purchase but the order shows failed. Refund still not received after a week.

title: Customer support very slow
text: In app chat support takes hours to respond and mostly gives generic replies that don't solve the issue.

title: Request: dark mode watchlist
text: Would love more customization on the watchlist and a proper dark mode across all screens.

title: Withdrawal delayed again
text: Second time this month my withdrawal has taken more than 4 working days. Support just says 'please wait'.

title: Clean and reliable
text: Been using this for a year now for SIPs, works well most of the time and the UI is clean.

title: KYC document upload fails
text: Document upload for KYC fails repeatedly on mobile data, only works on wifi. Needs fixing.

title: App crashed on results day
text: App crashed right after a big earnings announcement, right when I wanted to place an order. Bad timing.

title: Easy fund transfers
text: Adding money and investing is very smooth. Best app for someone who wants to start investing without confusion.

title: No update on my refund
text: A failed transaction refund has not come back after 6 days. Support keeps saying it is 'in process'.

title: Support ignored my ticket
text: Opened three support tickets for the same withdrawal delay issue and got no resolution, just copy paste replies.

title: Solid app, minor bugs
text: Mostly reliable, but sometimes the portfolio value doesn't refresh properly until I restart the app.

title: KYC rejected without reason
text: My KYC got rejected with no clear reason given. Had to redo the whole process from scratch.

title: Great UI for beginners
text: The whole app feels designed for people who are investing for the first time. Very approachable.

title: Login broken again
text: Could not log in for almost an hour today, right during market hours. Second time this happened this month.

title: Feature request: basket orders
text: Please add basket order support like other apps, would make multi-stock investing much faster.

title: Withdrawal stuck in processing
text: My withdrawal has been stuck in processing status for 7 days now with no update from the team.

title: App lags on older phones
text: App is quite heavy and lags a lot on my older phone, especially when switching between tabs.

title: Helpful for SIP tracking
text: Really like how it shows my SIP performance over time, makes it easy to stay on top of my investments.

title: Support unresponsive for days
text: Sent multiple messages about a payment issue and got zero response for over 4 days straight.

title: KYC verification slow
text: Bank account linking for KYC took over a week. Everything else about the app is fine though.

title: Very beginner friendly
text: I recommend this to all my friends who are new to the stock market, very easy to understand.

title: Crashes during high traffic
text: App becomes unusable when the market is very volatile, crashes or freezes right when I need it most.

title: Withdrawal delay with no explanation
text: Withdrawal request pending for 6 days, no explanation given despite asking support twice.

title: Good but chat support is weak
text: App itself works fine, but if you ever need help the chat support takes forever to actually resolve anything.

title: Watchlist needs personalization
text: Wish I could reorder and group my watchlist better, right now it feels a bit basic.

title: Bank verification loop
text: Stuck in a loop where KYC says pending, then failed, then pending again. No one can explain what's wrong.

title: Smooth experience overall
text: Very happy with the app, investing in mutual funds has never been this easy for me.

title: Support ticket closed without fix
text: My support ticket about a stuck withdrawal was closed as 'resolved' without actually returning my money.

title: App unstable on order day
text: App kept crashing on the day I wanted to place a large order, ended up missing the price I wanted.

title: KYC process needs streamlining
text: Too many steps for KYC that feel redundant, could easily be combined into fewer screens.

title: Nice for tracking portfolio
text: Good overview of my portfolio and mutual funds in one place, though I wish loading was faster.

title: Withdrawal still not received
text: It has now been over a week since I requested a withdrawal, funds still not credited to my bank.

title: Support response time is bad
text: Every time I raise an issue, it takes at least 2-3 days just to get a first reply from support.

title: Very good for new investors
text: Simple, clean, and great for someone starting their investing journey without getting overwhelmed.

title: App froze mid transaction
text: App froze while I was completing a payment, couldn't tell if money was deducted or not, quite scary.
